snippet.title: Pray & Slay — Official Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Our Pray & Slay demo is live on Steam!
Come give it a try — we'd love to hear what you think.

Steam Demo
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5112790/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=organic-social&utm_campaign=demo-launch-2026&utm_content=d02-trailer-description

You can also find the Steam link on our channel profile.

Wield holy light, unlock permanent upgrades, and turn a fragile priest into an overwhelming force.

Fight through fast-paced runs and return stronger each time. Build a screen-filling arsenal, unlock darker powers, and see how far your faith can take you.

Pray. Slay. Grow stronger. Repeat.

Developed by Atonal Games.

#IncrementalGame #IndieGame #PrayAndSlay
